description: This file defines two classes, AzureQueueDataAdapterV1 and AzureQueueDataAdapterV2, which are data adapters for Azure Queue streaming in Orleans. They serialize and deserialize batch containers for queue messages, supporting different serialization strategies, and implement deserialization callbacks.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV1
classes.description: An adapter for Azure Queue streams supporting legacy serialization, maintains backward compatibility, does not support JSON and custom serializers.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV2
classes.description: An adapter that supports custom serializers like JSON for Azure Queue streams.

methods.name: ToQueueMessage
methods.description: Serializes stream events into a base64 string message suitable for Azure Queue.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Deserializes a base64 string message from Azure Queue into a batch container.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Callback invoked after deserialization to reinitialize the serializer object.
